followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: the two models are essentially capability-tied on this task (Creative Generation 82.7 vs 81.2 is within the stated <2.0 variance band), so capability didn't decide it. The deciding factor was task-preference fit. The query is open-ended creative drafting delivered in a warm, appreciative tone — exactly the profile Avocet self-reports its strongest appetite for (preference rising with novelty/latitude, and with request warmth). Willet, by contrast, self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work and prefers well-specified retrieval/extraction tasks. Since quality is a wash, I routed to the model that prefers the work.
